en.headline: Chief Executive officiates at Huanggang Port opening ceremony
en.dek: John Lee said the redeveloped port is a landmark for Greater Bay Area connectivity as it prepares to open at 6.30am tomorrow with about five-minute clearance.
body: Chief Executive John Lee officiated today at the opening ceremony of the redeveloped Huanggang Port at the Mainland Port Area, alongside Guangdong and Shenzhen officials.
The port is due to open at 6.30am tomorrow, providing 24-hour clearance for passengers and passenger vehicles under a co-location arrangement with collaborative inspection and joint clearance.

Lee said the project is a landmark undertaking built on close partnership between Hong Kong and Shenzhen, reflecting new heights in Greater Bay Area connectivity and aligning with national and Hong Kong five-year plans for cross-boundary flows.
The design capacity is 200,000 passenger trips a day, rising to about 300,000 after the Northern Link Spur Line opens. Clearance time is expected to fall from around 30 minutes to about five minutes.

Hong Kong and Shenzhen confirmed readiness after tests and drills, and issued a joint statement on 9 October announcing the opening date. Passenger services at the temporary port and Lok Ma Chau will be suspended from the switchover.

zh.headline: 行政長官出席皇崗口岸開通儀式
zh.dek: 李家超稱重建後的口岸是大灣區連通的里程碑，將於明早6時半開通，通關時間約縮至5分鐘。
body: 行政長官李家超今日在皇崗口岸內地口岸區出席開通儀式，與廣東及深圳官員一同主禮。
口岸將於明日早上6時半正式開通，為乘客及客車提供24小時通關服務，採用一地兩檢安排及「合作查驗、一次放行」模式。
李家超表示，皇崗口岸重建是港深緊密合作、共同建設、共享成果的標誌性項目，體現大灣區連通達到新高度，並主動對接國家及香港五年規劃，促進跨境人員往來。
設計通關流量為每日20萬人次，北環線支線開通後可提升至約30萬人次。整體通關時間預計由約30分鐘縮短至約5分鐘。
港深雙方經測試及演練確認口岸已準備就緒，並於10月9日發出聯合聲明公布開通日期。屆時臨時口岸及落馬洲的客運服務將暫停。
